data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates the large service's redundancy with a counterfactual assumption that the heterogeneity budget is actually spent effectively, but its own countercondition admits that if all cells share the same flawed configuration management system, the redundancy is merely apparent. The problem stipulates the large service has 'strictly more total internal redundancy,' and SRC_001 never reconciles how 'strictly more redundancy' is meaningful when the mechanisms providing that redundancy (coordinated deployment, config management) are themselves the correlated failure vector. It smuggles in extra heterogeneity capacity not guaranteed by 'more redundancy,' so its defense of the large service rests on capabilities orthogonal to the stated comparison.
